scripts.dev: doppler secrets download --no-file --format=env -p temporium-api -c dev > .dev.vars.doppler && touch .dev.vars && wrangler dev --port 8008 --env-file .dev.vars.doppler --env-file .dev.vars
scripts.secrets:prod:sync: doppler secrets --json -p temporium-api -c prd | jq -c 'with_entries(select(.key | test("^DOPPLER_") | not) | .value = .value.computed)' | wrangler secret bulk --env production
scripts.release:prod: yarn db:prod:migrate && yarn secrets:prod:sync && yarn worker:prod:deploy
scripts.db:check: drizzle-kit generate --name drift_check 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q 'No schema changes' || (git checkout -- src/db/migrations/ >/dev/null 2>&1; git clean -fd src/db/migrations/ >/dev/null 2>&1; echo '\n✗ Schema drift: schema.ts has uncommitted changes. Run: yarn db:generate --name <descriptive_name>' && exit 1)
scripts.db:prod:migrate: yarn db:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply temporium-db --remote
